mapper.insert: INSERT INTO offline_package_manifest ( id, incident_id, manifest_version, operational_period_id, overall_search_area_id, overall_search_area_version, manifest_hash, manifest_format_version, manifest_payload, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{manifestId}, #{incidentId}, #{manifestVersion}, 'op-precinct-001-op1', 'osa-precinct-001', 1, '1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111', 1, '{}', #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO offline_package_installation ( id, offline_package_manifest_id, police_phone_id, last_reported_by_account_id, status, total_item_count, completed_item_count, failed_item_count, failed_item_keys, last_error_code, last_reported_at, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{record.id}, #{record.manifestId}, #{record.policePhoneId}, #{record.lastReportedByAccountId}, #{record.status}, #{record.totalItemCount}, #{record.completedItemCount}, #{record.failedItemCount}, #{record.failedItemKeys, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.StringListArrayTypeHandler}, #{record.lastErrorCode}, #{record.lastReportedAt}, #{record.version}, #{record.createdAt}, #{record.updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.offline_package_manifest_id, m.incident_id, i.police_phone_id, i.last_reported_by_account_id, i.status, i.total_item_count, i.completed_item_count, i.failed_item_count, i.failed_item_keys, i.last_error_code, i.last_reported_at, i.version, 901 AS sequence_number, i.status = 'READY' AS ready_for_offline_use, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM offline_package_installation i JOIN offline_package_manifest m ON m.id = i.offline_package_manifest_id WHERE i.offline_package_manifest_id = #{manifestId} AND i.police_phone_id = #{policePhoneId}

SELECT i.id, m.incident_id, i.police_phone_id, i.status, i.version, 901 AS sequence_number, m.manifest_version, i.status = 'READY' AS ready_for_offline_use FROM offline_package_installation i JOIN offline_package_manifest m ON m.id = i.offline_package_manifest_id WHERE m.incident_id = #{incidentId} ORDER BY CASE i.status WHEN 'READY' THEN 1 WHEN 'PARTIAL' THEN 2 WHEN 'STALE' THEN 3 WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, i.police_phone_id
